mechanism: Both drugs are substrates of CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion and may increase tolterodine levels, while tolterodine's anticholinergic effects may be potentiated.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, cognitive changes); consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if clinically significant symptoms develop.
